title: Moon Shard

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Can be sold for candy or used to craft the Celestial Hammer, Heavenly Pollaxe, and the Lunar Staff.

body:
"A portion of the moon that's broken off and hit the island. Some say that using different moon shards provide different luck."

Description

The Moon Shard is an item added in v1.68.0. In v1.68.1, each Moon Shard received a unique color and name. When you sell it, you will receive 500 Candy.

They can spawn anywhere at night, similar to ghosts and star spawns.

Also the shape of moon is based off the shape of moon on the sky.

Name Picture Quest Reward
Waning Crescent Moon Shard Starlight Sickle
Third Quarter Moon Shard Eclipse Crossbow
Waning Gibbous Moon Shard Celestial Hammer
Full Moon Shard Lunar Staff
Waxing Gibbous Moon Shard Heavenly Pollaxe
First Quarter Moon Shard Crater Chisel
Waxing Crescent Moon Shard Astral Saw

Trivia

  • When starting a new server, Waxing Crescent Moon Shard will always fall first.
  • The names of the moon shards are incorrect, due to the illumination area of the waning shards increasing and the illumination area of the waxing shards becoming smaller (should be other way around)
  • They spawn in a row ( 1.Waxing Crescent Moon Shard -> 2.Waning Crescent Moon Shard -> 3.Third Quarter Moon Shard -> 4.Waning Gibbous Moon Shard -> 5.Full Moon Shard -> 6.Waxing Gibbous Moon Shard -> 7.First Quarter Moon Shard) after 7th shard, it goes back to the 1st shard restarting the cycle again.
  • Similar to night items like fireflies and stars, or new ones like the ghosts, they disappear when the night ends if not claimed by a player.
